question: Design the node: an STM32G474 drives a DC motor with a 20 kHz PWM, talks UART at 115200 baud to an ESP32 and must stay under a 50 uA sleep-current budget. The system clock comes from the crystal soldered on my board (HSE) through the PLL, at the highest SYSCLK the chip allows. Which crystal I used is a fact about my board that no datasheet states. Decompose the work into steps, work out the clock and PLL configuration, check the logic-level compatibility between the STM32G474 and the ESP32 and check the sleep-current budget. Give the design as a numbered plan with the numbers.
